alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 5 at 3:21AM PST until November 5 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility down to 1/4 mile or less.

* WHERE...San Joaquin Valley.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways impacted include, but are not limited
to, Interstate 5, Highway 99, as well as State Routes 33, 41, 43,
46, 58, 140, 152, 168, 180, and 198.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
